name: Gwen
title: The Hallowed Seamstress

Q.name: Snip Snip!
Q.description: Passive: Gwen gains 1 stack when she hits an enemy with an attack (max 4, lasts 6 seconds). Active: Consumes stacks. Gwen snips once for 10/14/18/22/26 + 0.05×AP magic damage, snips again for each ammo consumed, and then snips a final time for 60/85/110/135/160 + 0.35×AP magic damage. The center of each strikes converts 50% of the damage into true damage instead and applies A Thousand Cuts to enemies hit. Deals 80% damage to minions. Minions below 20% health take 1000% bonus damage instead of reduced damage.
Q.summary: Gwen snips her scissors in a cone up to 6 times dealing magic damage. Gwen deals true damage to units in the center and applies her passive to them on each snip.

W.name: Hallowed Mist
W.description: Gwen summons the Hallowed Mist, making her Untargetable to all enemies (except towers) outside the zone for 4 seconds or until she leaves it. While in the Mist, Gwen gains 22/24/26/28/30 + 0.07×AP Armor and Magic Resist. Gwen can Recast this Ability once to call the Mist to her. This will automatically Recast the first time Gwen attempts to leave the zone.
W.summary: Gwen summons mist that protects her from enemies outside of it. She can only be targeted by enemies who enter the mist.

E.name: Skip 'n Slash
E.description: Gwen dashes and empowers her Attacks for 4 seconds. Empowered Attacks gain (30/42.5/55/67.5/80) × 0.01 Attack Speed, 15 + 0.2×AP magic damage %i:OnHit% On-Hit, 75 range, and the first one to hit an enemy refunds 25/35/45/55.0/65% of this Ability's Cooldown.
E.summary: Gwen dashes a short distance then gains Attack Speed, attack range, and magic damage On-Hit for a few seconds. If she hits an enemy during that time, this Ability's cooldown is partially refunded.

R.name: Needlework
R.description: First Cast: Hurl a needle that deals 30/50/70 + 0.1×AP magic damage, Slows by 40/50/60% for 1.5 seconds, and applies A Thousand Cuts to all enemies hit. Gwen can Recast this ability up to 2 additional times within 6 seconds (1s cooldown between casts). Second Cast: Fire three needles to deal (30/50/70 + 0.1×AP) × 3 magic damage Third Cast: Fire five needles to deal (30/50/70 + 0.1×AP) × 5 magic damage
R.summary: Gwen hurls a needle that slows enemies hit, deals magic damage, and applies A Thousand Cuts to champions hit. This ability can be cast up to two more times, with each cast throwing additional needles and dealing more damage.

Passive.name: A Thousand Cuts
Passive.description: Gwen's attacks deal bonus magic damage based on the targets health. She heals for a portion of the damage dealt to champions by this effect.
Passive.summary: Gwen's attacks deal bonus magic damage based on the targets health. She heals for a portion of the damage dealt to champions by this effect.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: AP skirmisher who stacks Q with attacks and fights inside W mist, where attackers outside can't reach her.
strengths: W mist makes her untargetable to enemies outside it
profile.curveNote: Trades around Q stacks + E dash + W; weak before first item.

P.notes: Attacks deal max-health magic damage and heal vs champions

Q.notes: Stacks from attacks; center deals true damage

W.notes: Untargetable to enemies outside the mist (except towers); step into it to hit her

E.notes: Dash; empowers attacks with range and attack speed

R.notes: Needles, recast up to 2 more times

profile.windowAgainst: When W is down, or by stepping into her mist.
